verdict.rationale: Sift's core product generates ML-based risk scores (0-100) and automated Workflows/Decisions that could be seen as data-driven insights surfaced to users, but there's no evidence of generative AI-style narrative insights, explanations, or proactive suggestions inside a UI—just scores and rule-based workflow automation. Missing for 10: evidence of natural-language AI-generated insights/explanations, proactive suggestion features, or any genAI assistant surfacing recommendations from data.
